subject: a row of three envelopes linked by a dotted line
sourceSummary: Design and build a multi-email lifecycle sequence (welcome, onboarding, nurture, re-engagement) that moves a subscriber from one stage to the next: it first maps the customer journey — entry trigger, the goal of each email, send timing/cadence, and the one CTA per email — then drafts every email's subject line, preview text, and body to its single goal, then builds the sequence into a client-safe, inline-styled HTML email set ready to load into an ESP.
